Working priorities · to agree together

This summary brings together six anonymous form submissions and additional points raised by representatives, as of 19 October. The English and Chinese forms are separate, so submissions may overlap. Representative additions are labelled below and do not increase the response count. These are issues to explore, not a representative survey of all PGR students.

04 / Daily research life

Space, access & connectivity

Reliable workspace, longer opening hours and dependable campus and mobile connectivity.

Agree the route and the responsible team ↗ 05 / Research support

Compute, funding & AI tools

Clarify compute allocations, funding routes and support for research AI tools.

Make the support routes clear ↗ 06 / Community & EDI

Belonging across sites

Include PGRs across locations through better notice, accessible formats and shared information.

Choose a practical next step ↗

Keep what works. Feedback also recognises prompt help with day-to-day School issues and useful induction talks that introduce research resources.

0411:5525 minutesThe student perspective / 学生反馈Workspace, opening hours and reliable connections.+
Purpose

Bring the practical conditions of daily research to the forum, while recognising the support that already works.

A dependable place to work

What we heardFeedback describes uncertainty around fixed workspaces and the disruption of hot-desking.

Question for the forum
  • What workspace and storage options are available to PGRs, and how should students raise unmet needs?

Follow-up ownerRelevant School operations or workspace team — confirm at the meeting.

Longer opening hours

Form feedback + representative requestThe forms raise evening and out-of-hours access at Temple Quarter. Representatives are asking for longer opening hours to support research.

Question for the forum
  • Could the School extend opening hours or trial later access? Who can approve a change, what safety or staffing conditions apply, and when could a decision be reviewed?

Campus and mobile connectivity

Additional representative pointPoor network connectivity and limited or unavailable 4G/LTE and 5G mobile signal have been raised at the new campus. The affected locations and extent still need to be established.

Question for the forum

0512:2015 minutesResearch support & development / 科研支持Compute, research funding and AI-tool costs.+
Purpose

Suggested 15-minute flow: 2 minutes for the HPC concern, 6 for staff responses, 4 for owners and next steps, and 3 for funding / AI-tool support.建议 15 分钟安排：2 分钟概述 HPC 反馈，6 分钟请相关老师回应，4 分钟确认负责人和下一步，3 分钟讨论经费／AI 工具支持。

HPC: the concern behind the questionHPC：反馈究竟在问什么

Recovered form feedback, paraphrased and anonymised. A response asks for better HPC access and allocation, specifically Isambard-AI allowances and AIRR Access approval. It argues that current internal resources are insufficient for some GPU-intensive AI/ML work and asks the School to coordinate access to a larger allocation.已恢复的匿名问卷反馈概述。一份回复希望改善 HPC 获取与分配，明确点名 Isambard-AI 使用额度和 AIRR Access 审批；认为校内资源难以满足部分 GPU 密集型 AI／机器学习研究，希望学院协调争取更多额度。

Flexible access to spare resources. The respondent reports seeing apparently idle GPUs after monthly one-off allocations and proposes more flexible additional allocations when capacity is available. This is a reported observation, not a verified utilisation assessment.空余资源的灵活使用。反馈者称每月 one-off 分配结束后仍观察到 GPU 空闲，希望空余时能更灵活地追加资源。这是反馈中的观察，并非已核实的利用率评估。

A long-unresolved AIRR application. The response reports a wait of nearly six months without a clear result or progress update, affecting research plans and experiments. It asks for more efficient processing and better transparency. The application route, submission date and current status need private verification; this is not a general AIRR processing-time claim.长期未决的 AIRR 申请。回复称一项申请已等将近半年，没有明确结果或进展更新，影响研究计划和实验安排，希望改善审批效率和透明度。具体申请渠道、提交日期和当前状态需私下核对；这不代表 AIRR 的一般审批时长。

Figures to verify: the response describes Bristol’s internal share of Isambard-AI as “about 5%” (“48,000 node hours”). The denominator, allocation period and current validity are unconfirmed. The recovered expanded record still cuts off the final sentence; the missing ending is not reconstructed. No current utilisation, individual award or approval status has been independently checked.待核实数字：回复将 Bristol 内部可分配的 Isambard-AI 份额描述为“约 5%（48,000 node hours）”，但其分母、分配周期和当前有效性未确认。已恢复的展开记录仍截断了最后一句，此处不补写缺失结尾。当前利用率、个人额度和审批状态均未独立核实。

Can the team clarify what the Bristol allocation covers and over which period, whether apparently idle capacity is available to these projects, and who can obtain a status update on a long-pending AIRR case?请对口团队说明 Bristol 配额覆盖的范围和周期、看似空闲的容量是否可供相关项目使用，以及由谁取得长期未决 AIRR 个案的状态更新。

Discussion proposal: assess suitable interim computing options while the application is pending. This is a proposed response to the problem, not a reconstruction of the missing sentence or a promise of additional resource.讨论建议：评估等待期间适用的计算资源选项。这是针对问题提出的建议，不是对原文缺失句子的补写，也不是追加资源承诺。

Separate the five possible bottlenecks分清五个可能卡住的环节

The questions below are diagnostic prompts, not five additional confirmed complaints.以下是用于查明原因的问题，不代表已经收到五类确证投诉。

  1. 1 · Application / 申请

    Which allocation route was used? Is the application complete, under review, awaiting compliance information or already decided? Who can check its status?走的是哪条分配渠道？申请是否完整、正在审核、等待补充合规资料，还是已经有决定？谁可以查询状态？

  2. 2 · Account / 开通

    Has an allocation been awarded but project membership, account activation or login is still unresolved?是否已经获批额度，但项目成员添加、账号开通或登录仍未完成？

  3. 3 · Allocation / 额度

    What is the remaining allowance, in which units, and when does it expire? What extra resource is needed and why?还剩多少额度、使用什么单位、何时到期？需要增加什么资源，研究依据是什么？

  4. 4 · Scheduling / 排队

    Is the job pending because of the requested resources, queue policy or project/user limits? Ask support to interpret the actual reason.任务是否因资源请求、调度规则或项目／用户限制而等待？请支持团队解读实际原因。

  5. 5 · Software and training / 软件与培训

    Does the user need help with software, the job script, GPU use or memory requirements? Is an existing course or support session suitable?是否需要软件、作业脚本、GPU 使用或内存需求方面的帮助？现有课程或支持活动是否适用？

Current routes to check first优先核对的现有渠道

Bristol internal route. Eligible staff lead the project; PGRs join as users. Current Isambard-AI guidance lists an initial 1,000 NHR, 500-NHR top-ups (up to five per project per year), and one-off allocations up to 1,000 NHR for 31 days when spare capacity is available. Requests go through the project Lead/Co-Lead.Bristol 内部渠道。由符合资格的教职工牵头，PGR 作为用户加入。当前 Isambard-AI 指引列明初始 1,000 NHR、每次 500 NHR 的追加额度（每项目每年最多五次），以及有空余容量时最长 31 天、最多 1,000 NHR 的一次性额度。由项目 Lead／Co-Lead 提交请求。

Bristol eligibility and allocation guidance ↗Bristol 资格与额度官方说明（英文）

National AIRR route. This is a separate allocation process. AIRR Gateway supports first use and benchmarking, with up to 10,000 GPU hours over three months. Check current eligibility and review timing; an internal top-up does not automatically extend an AIRR award.国家 AIRR 渠道。这是独立的分配流程。AIRR Gateway 支持初次使用和基准测试，最多提供三个月内使用的 10,000 GPU hours。须核对当前资格和评审时间；校内追加额度并不会自动延长 AIRR 项目。

AIRR Gateway guidance ↗ · Compare allocation routes ↗AIRR Gateway 官方说明及各分配渠道入口（英文）

Official guidance checked 21 October 2026. Subject to the provider’s current conditions; these are application options, not guaranteed awards.官方指引核对日期：2026 年 10 月 21 日。以服务方最新条件为准；以上是可申请的渠道，不是保证获批的额度。

Units, support and useful evidence单位、支持渠道与需要准备的信息

Node hours ≠ GPU hours. On Isambard-AI, 1 NHR corresponds to 4 GPU hours; charging also depends on the allocated CPU and memory share. Confirm the unit before comparing figures.Node hours 不等于 GPU hours。Isambard-AI 的 1 NHR 对应 4 GPU hours；核算还取决于分配的 CPU 和内存份额。比较数字前先确认单位。

Accounting ↗ · Job scheduling ↗额度核算与作业调度官方文档（英文）

Support: use the BriCS helpdesk for Isambard issues. For ACRC services, use ACRC support. Start with existing free ACRC training before proposing a new course.支持：Isambard 问题走 BriCS helpdesk；ACRC 服务走其官方支持渠道。先利用现有免费 ACRC 培训，再评估是否需要新增课程。

For a private support request, prepare the service/route, application date or error, requested resources, remaining allowance and expiry, and the research impact or deadline. Send project IDs and logs through the official support channel, not this public page.私下提交支持请求时，准备服务／申请渠道、提交日期或报错、所需资源、剩余额度及到期时间，以及科研影响或截止日期。项目编号和日志通过官方支持渠道提交，不放在本公开页面。

What we want to agree today本次会议希望确认什么

Who can liaise with the computing teams and obtain a written response on allocations, application progress and additional access?谁负责对接计算团队，并就额度、申请进度和追加资源取得书面答复？

Could PGRs have one short, maintained guide covering supervisor-led access, top-ups, national AIRR routes and technical support?能否为 PGR 提供一份持续维护的简明指南，覆盖导师牵头申请、追加额度、国家 AIRR 渠道和技术支持？

If the computing team is absent, who will take these questions forward, and by what date will we receive an initial update?如果计算团队未到场，由谁转交这些问题，何时给出第一次更新？

Suggested discussion lead: Alberto / the School PGR team, with the appropriate computing service. Allocation decisions remain with the relevant allocator. Confirm every action owner at the meeting.建议先由 Alberto／School PGR 团队协助对接相应计算服务；额度决定仍由相关分配方作出。每项行动负责人需在会议上确认。

The individual allocation and reported waiting time remain unverified. Use the dated official guidance above to frame questions, not to infer the outcome of a particular application.个人额度和报告的等待时间尚未核实。以上注明日期的官方说明用于帮助提问，不能据此推定某项申请的结果。
